verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents version tracking ("see which versions of your code are throwing exceptions") and deploy tracking. Those are per-version error attribution, a related but different feature. Nothing in the pack shows crash-free session or user rates, per-release adoption metrics, or a canary-versus-stable comparison view, so the release-health axis applies but has no direct evidence.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can watch release health — crash-free sessions and users, adoption per release — and compare a canary release against the last stable one
